name: Mysterious Girl
source: Girl that Kaison knew when he was a child. She is the only person he can still remember from his past, before he lost his memories, though he cannot remember her name beyond the nickname he's given her. She is hinted to be the same person as Shirley Primer, but this is not confirmed. At the end of the demo, we see an older her apparently talking to someone.
